name: game-art-direction
tagline_zh: 游戏设计文档还是干巴巴的？把它丢进来，立刻产出可落地的美术方向：镜头语法、色彩材质、HUD反馈、音频动效。
tagline_en: Turn a dry game design doc into a production-ready art bible: camera grammar, color/material, HUD, motion, audio.
desc_en: Direct game art and creative vision. Turn GAME_DESIGN into a production-level ART_DIRECTION defining a recognizable visual style, camera and composition, world and character grammar, functional colour/light/material, HUD feedback, motion and transition specs, audio direction, and a signature moment for every screen and mode. Use for what should the game look like, set the art direction, define the
why_zh: 同类只给风格参考，它直接生成可执行的视觉规范，连镜头和转场都写清参数，美术团队拿来就能开工。
why_en: Others give moodboards; this one outputs executable specs—camera, color, HUD, motion—so your art team can start production.
unshelve_reason: 问二 · 同类聚簇审查（worldwonderer 网文套件（在架 10 件：oh-story 7 + novel-to-game 3））。同上，且它在流水线上比 game-concept 更靠后（依赖 GAME_DESIGN.md，而 game-world-design 根本不在架上），单独安装必然空转。 正文原话：读取 [art-direction-method.md](references/art-direction-method.md)。必须已有 `GAME_DESIGN.md` 与 `PRODUCT_BRIEF.md`；视觉服务玩法，不能用漂亮参考图重写游戏。（对照 novel-to-game 正文：『6. 调用 `game-art-direction` 生成 `ART_DIRECTION.md`』）
